## Pattern.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `form` :: The repeating motif, drawn with CSS gradients.
- `tile` :: Tile size of the pattern, as a CSS length.
- `fade` :: A mask that fades the pattern out.
- `tone` :: Colour of the pattern, taken from the shared tone axis.
